tasks.title: Announcement #42
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.
tasks.transcript: Man: Attention, students. Due to construction, we've had to temporarily reduce the number of available parking spaces on campus. Because of this, the off campus shuttle will now begin running at 6:00 AM rather than 8:00 AM. If you are driving, please pay close attention to the postage signage and make sure that you are parking in your designated area. Student cars parked in faculty lots at any time will be ticketed or tolled. Please visit the Parking Services website if you need to pay a ticket.

questions.stem: What change to the off-campus shuttle does the speaker mention?

options.B: It can now be tracked through a website.
options.C: Its hours of operation have been extended.
options.D: Signs have been posted to mark its stops.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 说话者提到了关于校外班车的什么变化？ 定位原文: "Because of this, the off campus shuttle will now begin running at 6:00 AM rather than 8:00 AM." 选项分析: A. It now serves additional neighborhoods. (它现在服务更多的社区。) - 错误。文中未提及服务区域的变化。 B. It can now be tracked through a website. (现在可以通过网站追踪它。) - 错误。文中未提及追踪功能。 C. Its hours of operation have been extended. (它的运营时间延长了。) - 正确。班车从早上 8 点提前到 6 点开始运行，意味着运营时间向前延伸了，服务时长增加。 D. Signs have been posted to mark its stops. (张贴了标志来标记站点。) - 错误。文中提到的“signage”是指停车场的指示牌，而不是班车站点的标志。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker tell students to visit a website?

options.C: To view the number of available spaces

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 说话者为什么告诉学生去访问网站？ 定位原文: "Please visit the Parking Services website if you need to pay a ticket." 选项分析: A. To get directions to campus (为了获取去校园的路线) - 错误。文中未提及。 B. To read construction updates (为了阅读施工更新) - 错误。虽然提到了施工，但网站是为了处理罚单。 C. To view the number of available spaces (为了查看可用停车位数量) - 错误。文中只说车位减少了，没说要上网查数量。 D. To pay a fine (为了支付罚款) - 正确。文中明确说 "pay a ticket"，这里的 "ticket" 指的是违章停车罚单，即罚款（fine）。
